Anant Jain is a Software Engineer with experience building full-stack applications and AI-powered solutions for business workflows. His work spans backend engineering, application development, and intelligent automation, with a focus on building reliable and practical software solutions.

His work spans backend and full-stack development, API design, databases, and AI/GenAI applications. He has worked on financial and procurement platforms, AI assistants, RAG systems, LLM-based workflows, and automation solutions. He focuses on translating complex business requirements into scalable and production-ready software.

Anant joined the founding technology team at PV Advisory and has worked across software engineering and product development. His experience includes building business applications, backend systems, and AI-driven capabilities, taking solutions from development through production.

Anant holds a Bachelor of Commerce from the University of Delhi. Beyond work, Anant enjoys thinking about people, life, ambition, and the choices that shape who we become. He is guided by a strong belief in kindness and empathy, while remaining curious about the world and what makes us human.
